title: Ciphertext rare-letter position prior v1
rationale: This lane is a ciphertext-only preregistered target, not another public-anchor mining pass. It does not add candidate words, routes, claimed plaintext, public-anchor additive fragments, or anchor-derived match counts as evidence. Public anchors are used only as an exclusion mask so future scoring is limited to independently sourced non-anchor observations.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in the predeclared rare-ciphertext-letter positions from the committed artifact at a rate exceeding seeded same-size non-anchor position-shuffle and multiple-comparison controls.
discovery_inputs: Fixed exclusion mask for already-known clue spans, used only to set the future non-anchor target universe
Fixed rule: count ciphertext letters across non-anchor positions, choose the 20 positions whose letters are rarest, and tie-break by lower one-based position
evaluation_inputs: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations
Source-reviewed observation files with eligible source IDs, one-based positions, per-position notes, and rationale declared before evaluation
Position-only scoring target that excludes public anchor additive fragments as primary evidence
controls: source-backed observation file required before scoring
multiple-comparison context across all preregistered independent lanes before interpretation
require-unique-artifact gate for any lane intended to add a new prediction target
promotion blocked unless future independent observations beat controls without post-hoc retuning
